This application coming on for order this day, th e Cou  following:
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.32/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District - Dhar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 323, 294 and 506 of IPC.

sentences.text: 2. Prosecution story, in brief, is that the prosecutrix is aged about 26 years.
Prior to the date of incident, applicant and prosecutrix were known to each other.
On 28.03.2022, applicant met the prosecutrix at her room and on the false pretext of marriage, he committed rape upon her repeatedly.
Prosecutrix lived with the applicant for about 05 months meanwhile, applicant had also developed sexual relations with her.
Thereafter, some dispute arose between them, then she reported the matter against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
On the date of incident, prosecutrix was a major lady and she was also a consenting party for sexual intercourse.
FIR was lodged belatedly by more than a year therefore, case of the prosecution is doubtful.
Applicant is a reputed person and the police is trying to arrest him.
If police arrests him, his reputation will be spoiled therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be granted anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State/non-applicant has objected the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to the enlarged on anticipatory bail hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
6.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant - Narayan Mujalda shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before the Trial Court on all dates and for complying with the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
7. M.Cr.C. stands disposed of, accordingly.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
